Inside Manual Optimization.

Nine areas, tuned together. The four marked Core matter most.

01Core

BIOS

Power-saving off, unused motherboard devices disabled, performance settings tuned.

02Core

Windows

Fresh install or dual boot when needed, plus deep registry and system tuning.

03Core

GPU

Lower latency, hidden power settings adjusted, less throttling and background logging.

04Core

Network

Gaming-tuned settings, lower latency, gaming traffic prioritized, power saving off.

05

Power

The custom Quilted Power Plan and tuned CPU power behavior.

06

Startup and debloat

Unneeded startup apps and preinstalled apps removed, less background activity.

07

Devices and software

USB and device power saving off. Discord, browsers and apps configured.

08

Boot, services, drivers

A cleaner boot, trimmed services and drivers, dual boot created.

09

Security mitigations

Performance-impacting mitigations (VBS, CFG, Spectre/Meltdown) reviewed where applicable.

FAQ

Straight answers.

Is it free?

Optimizer V4 and Snip are free. Manual Optimization is $25, and Quilted Premium Utility is $15.

How do I get Manual Optimization?

Click Buy Manual Optimization to pay directly on this page. After purchase, follow the delivery instructions to arrange your session with us on Discord.

Will it raise my FPS?

It can, but results vary with hardware, drivers and the state of your Windows install. We do not promise specific numbers. With Manual Optimization we give you the best drivers and base the whole optimization around your hardware.

How do I get Premium Utility?

to open checkout on this page. Your purchase instructions and key are delivered through checkout.

Can I use one key on multiple PCs?

Each key activates on one PC. If you change hardware and need a device reset, contact support with your order details.

Does Snip slow my games?

No. It only wakes when you press the hotkey. In exclusive-fullscreen games the capture can come out black, so use borderless or windowed fullscreen.
